subject: MPA + legal sequencing: acceptance checkpoints and owner commitments
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novalign.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: MAP & procurement sequencing for pilot (Novalign)

Hi Alex / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Novalign is aligned on the pilot objectives and we'd like to start mapping procurement steps so we can land an August kick-off. Key asks: a) a mutual action plan (high-level owners + dates) we can share with procurement, b) visibility on legal sequencing (MSA vs DPA vs Order Form) and blockers, and c) a short evaluation acceptance checklist we can use internally.

Our procurement lead (cc'd in follow-up) will need a clear order of operations and which milestones gate signature vs operations. Can you share a draft MPA and a recommended close cadence?

Appreciate it,
Marta Lopez
Head of Programs — Novalign Health
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novalign.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement sequencing for pilot (Novalign)

Marta — thanks, this is helpful context. I've attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-draft-20280720.xlsx) and a short SOW-outline you can use for internal alignment. High-level notes here: 

- Proposal: split the engagement into Evaluation (4 weeks) and Pilot Production (3 months) with acceptance checkpoints at Eval-week-2 and Eval-completion.
- Legal sequencing: recommend executing a lightweight order form + Fallback Data Processing Addendum (DPA) to enable the pilot, with MSA signature targeted during pilot ramp (so production is not blocked by full MSA redline cycles).
- Owners: Alex (commercial), Laura (onboarding & acceptance), Jonas (technical validation), Kimberly (legal questions/redlines).

Kimberly — can you confirm whether the proposed MSA cadence (order form + DPA first, MSA later) is acceptable from risk/compliance perspective? Specifically, procurement asks whether we can provision isolated pilot capacity under an order form before the MSA is finalized.

Marta — I'll update the MAP with dates once Kimberly confirms.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft-20280720.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-outline-brief.pdf (pdf)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novalign.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement sequencing for pilot (Novalign)

Alex / team — quick legal read. Summary: the order form + DPA-first approach is operationally feasible for a bounded pilot, but we need explicit gating language in the MAP and order form that limits production usage and data residency. If Novalign will process PHI or regulated data, we need an executed BAA; otherwise a scoped DPA with processing limitations is acceptable. 

Action items from legal's side:
- Provide a redline of our standard MSA and an appendix DPA (attached: redline_MSA_20280720.docx).
- Add gating clause to the order form: "Pilot Mode — limited to non-production workloads and agreed data sets."
- Define acceptance criteria that trigger the Order Form conversion to full Production (e.g., performance metrics, security checklist, successful eval tests).

Two asks for the commercial/onboarding side:
1) Specify who signs the order form (procurement vs business lead) and the billing contact.
2) Confirm expected go/no-go dates for the two acceptance checkpoints so legal can tier evidence review (logs, SOC 2 artifacts).

I'll keep redlines tight. If procurement wants the MSA fully executed before any provisioning, we'll flag that as a scope change that delays start by ~3 weeks.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline_MSA_20280720.docx (docx)
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novalign.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novalign.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-21T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement sequencing for pilot (Novalign)

Thanks — this approach makes sense. A few clarifications from procurement:

- We can accept an order form + scoped DPA to start, provided there is a clear conversion milestone to a fully executed MSA before any PHI or production traffic.
- Signing authority: procurement will sign the order form; legal prefers business sign-off for the MSA finalization.
- Tentative internal dates: eval-start target Aug 7; eval-complete Aug 31. Procurement asks for the MAP owners + one-page timeline they can include in the internal purchase memo.

Can you send a single-sheet MAP that lists owners, dates, gating criteria, and the minimal docs we need for evidence (SOC2 report, DPA, onboarding checklist)? Procurement will review and loop in our security team if needed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Marta
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novalign.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-22T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement sequencing for pilot (Novalign)

Marta — attached is the consolidated one-sheet MAP and an owner-level timeline (MPA-owners-timeline-20280722.xlsx). Key commitments: 

- Eval window: 2028-08-07 -> 2028-08-31
  - Eval checkpoint 1 (2028-08-14): functional smoke tests + configuration handoff (owner: Jonas)
  - Eval acceptance (2028-08-31): pass acceptance tests + security checklist (owner: Laura)

- Legal/procurement cadence:
  - Order form + scoped DPA signed by procurement (target: 2028-07-29) -> provision sandbox capacity
  - MSA finalization (target: 2028-08-21) -> convert to production order form if accepted

- Required evidence bundle for procurement: SOC2 report (most recent), scoped DPA, onboarding checklist, and operational runbook. I've attached links to the Drive folder and created a HubSpot note (DEAL-9364) with the timeline.

Next steps:
1) Marta/procurement: confirm signatory and billing contact by EOD 2028-07-23.
2) Kimberly: please confirm redline turnaround expectation (you mentioned tight timeline — is an initial redline by 2028-07-25 realistic?).
3) Jonas & Laura: I'll schedule a 30-min intake to align on acceptance test specs this week.

Links:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/DEAL-9364
- Drive: https://drive.company/drive/folders/1a2b3c-mpa-draft
- DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/MPA-9364

Thanks — sending the attached files now.

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
